name: vru-marketplace-backend
description: VRU Marketplace — community marketplace backend (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.db:seed-all: npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-staging.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-all-sellers-full-dashboard.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-coupons.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-qa-scenarios.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test

_comment_overrides: Transitive deps pinned to patched versions because `npm audit fix` would downgrade NestJS or Prisma by a major version instead. multer: @nestjs/platform-express pins 2.2.0, which carries four high-severity DoS advisories (GHSA-wc9g-mqfw-jrwm and friends); 2.3.0 fixes them and is API-compatible; 2.4.0 also fixes GHSA-3pph-fpjx-jg34 (orphaned disk writes on aborted uploads — this app uses memory storage, but the tree should still be clean). @nestjs/platform-express 12.1.1 pins 2.4.0 itself, so this entry goes once NestJS is bumped. deepmerge-ts and mysql2: both reached only through the prisma CLI (a devDependency), GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx and GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr. We never speak MySQL, but a vulnerable package in the tree is still a package someone has to reason about. Drop each entry once its parent depends on the patched version itself.
